short: Meta's AI division, long known for the open-weight Llama models and now also home to Meta Superintelligence Labs.
definition: Meta AI is the artificial intelligence organization at Meta, the parent of Facebook and Instagram, spanning fundamental research (FAIR) and applied products. It built its reputation on the open-weight Llama models, which anyone can download and which seeded a large open-source ecosystem of fine-tunes and tools. Since 2025, Meta's push toward frontier AI has centered on Meta Superintelligence Labs, a newly formed group whose closed Muse model line, not Llama, now drives Meta's most capable releases and consumer AI features.
